description:
Import historical stock price data for Apple Inc (AAPL) into Portfolio Performance. A portfolio file with Apple Inc (with no price data) is available at /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/investment_portfolio.xml. Open this file in Portfolio Performance if it is not already open.

Import the CSV file at /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/aapl_historical_quotes.csv as historical quotes for the Apple Inc (AAPL) security. The CSV uses semicolon (;) as delimiter and contains Date and Quote columns with daily closing prices from January to June 2024.

Associate the imported data with the Apple Inc security and save the portfolio file.
